description: Test vectors for the initials rule signer-v1 (spec/envelope-format.md §4.6, core/signpdf-core/src/initials.rs): the letters a signer chose for their initials, kept in their signature record and stamped in their further initials fields. 'valid' and 'invalid' are what a writer accepts and a verifier expects (1 to 3 initials letters: A-Z, a-z, U+00C0-U+00FF except U+00D7 and U+00F7, and Š š Œ œ Ž ž Ÿ: the letters WinAnsiEncoding draws except ª º µ ƒ ˆ; nothing else, no normalization). 'prefill' is the starting value a host offers: the name-v1 letters of the slot's name, else of the verified email address, keeping initials letters only, at most 3; null when none is left. Every implementation (the engine, a signing page, an independent verifier) must agree on every case.

valid.note: small letters are kept as typed
the widest capitals still fit the default 60 x 32 box at full size

invalid.note: ordinal indicator: WinAnsi draws it, but it is not an initial
a letter the stamp font cannot draw: the signer writes L
Greek capital alpha, which looks like A
Cyrillic capital A, which looks like A
decomposed: a host sends the composed É (NFC)

prefill.name: Иван Петров
prefill.note: an address of digits leaves nothing: the signer types their own
